svg.desc: Seconds; darker cells have lower mean TTFT. A dash means no observed turns or unavailable data, not zero latency. Blank and zero no-sample states are both displayed as dashes.
svg.text: Mean TTFT by observed context band — all 41 sweep cells
Seconds; darker cells have lower mean TTFT. A dash means no observed turns or unavailable data, not zero latency. Blank and zero no-sample states are both
TTFT includes queueing, cache recovery and prefill. These are context-band means, not percentiles or isolated kernel rates.
Rows preserve CSV cell IDs and order. No interpolation into unobserved depth bands.
